part.label: Dome With Ellipsoid Cap
part.description: A base plate topped with a stretched, dome-shaped cap -- the `ellipsoid` component kind (a sphere stretched independently along each axis) sits with its base (not its center) at Z=0 on its own local origin, the same convention as every other kind, so it composes with `on_top_of` exactly like any other component.

components.description: Stretched dome cap, resting on top of the base via an ordinary on_top_of relation.
